behaviorChanges: new `tautline decisions-report` verb + session-journal decision window/pointer/watermark lines -- machine-local read surface over the decision ledger; counts explicitly scoped to retained rotations; no gate, guard, or review behavior changed

requiredMigrations.command: gh auth refresh --hostname github.com -s read:project -s project
requiredMigrations.description: Carried forward from 0.10.3 for lanes updating across it: grant the gh token the GitHub Projects scopes the fail-closed board gates need. Machines already on 0.10.3+ or whose token carries read:project and project need no action.

rollbackNotes: Repinning below this release removes `decisions-report` and the journal decision lines; recorded decision events and existing journals (including watermark lines, which the older validator ignores as unknown optional content) remain inert and compatible; no state migration required.
